decision.pytest_source:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from part2.capital_flow import runner

@pytest.mark.parametrize("failed_output", [
    "latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json"
])
def test_interrupted_publication_failpoint_matrix(tmp_path, monkeypatch, failed_output):
    t0, t1 = 1800000000000, 1800000060000
    names = ("latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json")
    runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=t0)
    def stamps():
        return [json.loads((tmp_path / n).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["as_of_ms"] for n in names]
    assert stamps() == [t0, t0, t0]
    original = runner.atomic_write_json
    attempts = []
    def injected(path, payload):
        if Path(path).name == failed_output:
            attempts.append(failed_output)
            raise RuntimeError("injected_publication_failure")
        return original(path, payload)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "atomic_write_json", injected)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected_publication_failure"):
        runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=t1)
    assert attempts == [failed_output]
    assert stamps() == [t0, t0, t0], (failed_output, stamps())
